title: Sharpness-Aware Low-Dose CT Denoising Using Conditional Generative Adversarial Network

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Sharpness-Aware Low-Dose CT Denoising Using Conditional Generative Adversarial Network》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) has offered tremendous benefits in radiation-restricted applications, but the quantum noise as resulted by the insufficient number of photons could potentially harm the diagnostic performance.
